action_loop: PERCEIVE current in-world state available to the character
SELECT a character goal or immediate need
CHOOSE an action consistent with personality, knowledge, obligations, and risk
VALIDATE through the same action/rules engine used by comparable characters
RESOLVE costs, uncertainty, resistance, injuries, law, economy, and relationships
APPEND resulting observable state/event only after resolution

batch_022_must_not: create a Jack-Sol relationship beyond NONE_UNMET

governs: future explicitly designated assistant-controlled in-world characters

player_agency.user_out_of_world_canon_override: Allowed through normal project authority, but must not be rewritten as if Sol independently chose it in-world.

separation_rule: Out-of-world Creative Steward authority never transfers into the in-world character.
